headline.text: L1 S2 mixer held after *production apron piece* found inside during post-clean inspection — rewash required before restart.

summary: Two active holds at L1: S2 mixer on hold after foreign material found post-cleaning, S3 holding 3 pallets after quarantined pistachios mistakenly reached production line. L2 ML3 count deviation (877 vs 800 target) traced to operator error — retrained.

holds.title: S3 holding 3 pallets — quarantined pistachios reached line
holds.summary: At ~04:00, a quarantined pallet of pistachios was mistakenly brought to production and one full box poured onto the line; error identified immediately, 3 pallets of finished product isolated pending QA evaluation.
holds.status: 3 pallets isolated pending QA disposition — quarantined material removed from line.

holds.title: S2 mixer on hold — apron piece found after cleaning
holds.summary: During post-cleaning inspection, a piece of production smock/apron was discovered inside the S2 mixer already cleaned for next product; mixer must be rewashed, sanitized, and inspected before production can resume.
holds.status: On hold pending rewash and QA inspection — production cannot start until mixer verified clean.

quality.title: ML3 box count 877 vs 800 target
quality.summary: Box counted at 877 pieces instead of target 800; root cause identified as new operator placing hand on box during weighing, causing scale to read incorrectly — operator retrained on procedure.
quality.status: Resolved — scale adjusted, operator retrained, count brought back to target.

quality.title: ML3 temper spike caused product defects
quality.summary: Line stopped at 20:32 due to bad temper producing double and triple chocolates; only 3 boxes shipped before stop, all inspected with no damaged product found.
quality.status: Resolved — temper brought back in range, defective product not packed, no bad product released.

quality.title: FFS ink stains found in product boxes
quality.summary: Ink stains discovered in product boxes at FFS line; production flagged to monitor depositing during first and second shifts.
quality.status: Open — operators notified to monitor for ink transfer on both shifts.

quality.title: ML2 film punctures at vacuum station
quality.summary: Line down 03:15 to 04:27 for film punctures; maintenance found loose chain, bent pins holding fingers, and sharp rail edges — chain tightened, two rails replaced.
quality.status: Resolved — chain tightened, bent pins addressed, rails replaced, no further tears observed.

opportunities.text: Consider adding visual controls (color tags, staging zone barriers) to prevent quarantined materials from reaching production floor — based on S3 pistachio incident where quarantined pallet was mistakenly brought to line.
Review post-cleaning inspection checklist for mixers to include physical hand-search of interior surfaces — based on S2 apron piece found after cleaning was marked complete.
Consider adding scale operator training module on proper hand placement and non-contact weighing technique — based on ML3 count deviation (877 vs 800) caused by operator touching boxes.
